select fs.*, p.name as product_name from mall_flash_sale fs left join mall_product p on p.product_id = fs.product_id
AND fs.product_id = #{productId} AND fs.status = #{status} AND fs.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
order by fs.create_time desc
select fs.*, p.name as product_name from mall_flash_sale fs left join mall_product p on p.product_id = fs.product_id where fs.sale_id = #{saleId}

select sale_id, product_id, title, flash_price, stock_limit, sold_count, per_limit, start_time, end_time, status, create_time from mall_flash_sale where product_id = #{productId} and status = '1' and now() between start_time and end_time limit 1
